positions.name: Ford Motor Company
positions.catalyst: Q2'26 (reported 7/28 after close) beat-and-raise: adj EPS $0.42 vs $0.35 est; adj EBIT $2.5B vs $2.15B est (5.2% margin, +0.9pp YoY). Stock jumped ~8% after-hours Tuesday; opened Wed pre-market ~+5.6% at 15.80 (bid 15.77 / ask 15.87, live 11:37-11:38 UTC print).
positions.driver: Fresh, confirmed overnight beat-and-raise on a highly liquid mega-cap with a tight spread. Pre-market gaps can fade at the regular open (sell-the-news). Hard stop 14.85 (-6%).
